GE HealthCare received FDA 510(k) clearance for Carescape ONE; Carescape Dock F0; TruSignal ECG MM; TruSignal PRES MM; TruSignal TEMP MM; TruSignal SpO2 MM 1.8M; TruSignal SpO2 MM 3.0M, according to a public record published by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

The entry, filed under identifier K260656, states that the action was taken on September 1, 2026. The record lists the Carescape ONE; Carescape Dock F0; TruSignal ECG MM; TruSignal PRES MM; TruSignal TEMP MM; TruSignal SpO2 MM 1.8M; TruSignal SpO2 MM 3.0M under advisory committee "Cardiovascular" and describes the outcome as "Substantially Equivalent". The filing is retrievable from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration public database, and the entry carries product code MHX with device class 2.

No additional submissions are listed against this identifier in the retrieved entry.
